question: Can future development and release creation continue if the legacy workspace is read-only or offline?
scope: Canonical four-contour operational workflow only; archived historical reproducibility is not reclassified as current workflow.

existing_inventoried_debt.interpretation: Historical/research path debt remains inventoried and is not mass-fixed in C2.5. It is not an allowed entrypoint for the canonical workflow.

release_feasibility.development: 01_Test has an independent Git checkout and copied research assets.
release_feasibility.promotion: 02_Predfin has its own exact checkout, physical model closure and acceptance evidence.
release_feasibility.release: 03_Fin has an immutable verified release and transfer artifact.

limitations: Some archived notebooks and historical research records retain legacy absolute paths.
Those files may require explicit rehabilitation before reuse; they are not canonical operational entrypoints.
GitHub/network and separately provisioned runtime dependencies remain external dependencies, but neither is the legacy workspace.
